question: What's the difference between a critical and a non-critical violation, and how does each affect an inspection score?
output_text:
A **critical violation** is a citation whose violation code is flagged as `critical` in the SLCHD portal data. A **non-critical violation** is one flagged `critical = false`. The dataset does not provide a further narrative definition of the risk distinction or a published point schedule by violation type, so I can’t responsibly claim a fixed number of score points per critical versus non-critical citation.

For scoring:

- The **inspection score is total violation points** for that visit: **0 means clean, and higher scores are worse**.
- Both critical and non-critical citations can contribute to the score, but the available data do **not** establish a universal “critical = X points / non-critical = Y points” rule.
- In the recorded inspections, critical citations appeared in **9,690 cited-violation rows** (**10,744 occurrences**), while non-critical citations appeared in **22,339 rows** (**25,862 occurrences**).
- Inspections containing a critical citation had an average score of **21.6** (among citation rows), compared with **15.9** for inspections containing a non-critical citation. That association does not by itself prove the point value of either type, since inspections can contain multiple citations of both types.

The chart shows average inspection scores grouped by whether an inspection had critical citations, non-critical citations, both, or no cited violations.

messages.name: get_schema

messages.content: {"description": "Whether citations of this code are critical. One fixed value per code \u2014 verified across all citations, no code has mixed critical/non-critical citations. (3 codes were found inconsistently labeled in the raw source and were normalized to critical=true; see data/processed/clean_processed.ipynb, 'Fix inconsistent violation criticality'.)", "reference": "slchd_portal"}
messages.name: get_column_glossary

args.query: SELECT vc.critical, COUNT(*) AS cited_violation_rows, SUM(COALESCE(v.violation_occurrences, 1)) AS total_occurrences, MIN(i.inspection_score) AS min_score, MAX(i.inspection_score) AS max_score, AVG(i.inspection_score) AS avg_score FROM violations v JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id JOIN inspections i ON v.inspection_id = i.inspection_id GROUP BY vc.critical ORDER BY vc.critical DESC

SELECT i.inspection_score, SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN COALESCE(v.violation_occurrences,1) ELSE 0 END) AS critical_occurrences, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT vc.critical THEN COALESCE(v.violation_occurrences,1) ELSE 0 END) AS noncritical_occurrences FROM inspections i LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id=v.inspection_id LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id=vc.violation_code_id GROUP BY i.inspection_id, i.inspection_score ORDER BY i.inspection_score DESC LIMIT 10

messages.content: {"description": "Total violation points for this inspection. 0 = clean. Higher = worse (confirmed: inspections with any cited violation average score 17.6 vs 1.7 for clean ones).", "reference": "slchd_portal"}
messages.name: get_column_glossary

args.query: WITH per_inspection AS ( SELECT i.inspection_id, i.inspection_score, SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN COALESCE(v.violation_occurrences, 1) ELSE 0 END) AS critical_occurrences, SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical = FALSE THEN COALESCE(v.violation_occurrences, 1) ELSE 0 END) AS noncritical_occurrences FROM inspections i LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON vc.violation_code_id = v.violation_code_id GROUP BY i.inspection_id, i.inspection_score ) SELECT CASE WHEN critical_occurrences > 0 AND noncritical_occurrences > 0 THEN 'Both types cited' WHEN critical_occurrences > 0 THEN 'Critical only' WHEN noncritical_occurrences > 0 THEN 'Non-critical only' ELSE 'No cited violations' END AS citation_group, ROUND(AVG(inspection_score), 1) AS average_inspection_score FROM per_inspection GROUP BY citation_group ORDER BY average_inspection_score DESC
args.title: Average inspection score by cited violation type
